title: MC-Sparse: Deconstructing and Closing the Dense-Sparse Attention Gap in Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: MC-Sparse：解构并弥合扩散Transformer中稠密注意力与稀疏注意力之间的差距

paragraphs.en: Sparse attention is a primary approach to reducing the latency of diffusion transformers in long-sequence generation tasks, such as video and high-resolution 3D asset generation. However, existing methods can degrade generation quality and fidelity at high sparsity levels. Through controlled oracle comparisons, we trace this degradation to three sources: constraints imposed by token grouping, inaccurate interaction selection, and the attention contributions lost when tokens are discarded. Guided by this analysis, we propose Meta-Cached Sparse Attention (MC-Sparse), a training-free framework that selects individual key-value (KV) tokens while organizing similar queries into tile-aligned groups for efficient GPU execution. MC-Sparse caches metadata comprising query groups, KV indices selected using exact attention probabilities, and residuals between dense and sparse attention outputs, and reuses them across subsequent denoising steps. Across video and 3D generation models, MC-Sparse achieves higher fidelity to dense-attention outputs and larger denoising speedups than existing sparse-attention baselines, without visible quality degradation. Relative to dense attention, it delivers a 1.80 × 1.80\times denoising speedup on Minimax-H3-Base and a 2.32 × 2.32\times speedup on 3D asset generation, both with negligible quality loss.
paragraphs.zh: 稀疏注意力是降低扩散Transformer在长序列生成任务（如视频和高分辨率3D资产生成）中延迟的主要方法之一。 然而，现有方法在高稀疏度水平下可能会降低生成的质量和保真度。 通过受控的“神谕”对比，我们追踪到这种性能下降源于三个因素：由令牌分组带来的约束、不准确的交互选择，以及令牌被丢弃时损失的注意力贡献。 基于这一分析，我们提出了Meta-Cached Sparse Attention（MC-Sparse）——一个无需训练的框架，它通过选择单个键值（KV）令牌，并将相似查询组织成与瓦片对齐的组，以实现高效的GPU执行。 MC-Sparse缓存了包含查询组、使用精确注意力概率选择的KV索引，以及密集注意力与稀疏注意力输出之间残差的元数据，并在后续的去噪步骤中重复利用这些数据。 在视频和3D生成模型中，MC-Sparse相比现有的稀疏注意力基线方法，能够更紧密地匹配密集注意力的输出，并实现更快的去噪加速，同时不会出现明显的质量下降。 与密集注意力相比，它在Minimax-H3-Base模型上实现了1.80 × 1.80\times的去噪加速，在3D资产生成任务中实现了2.32 × 2.32\times的加速，且两者均几乎没有质量损失。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion transformers ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) have become a dominant backbone for high-fidelity video and 3D asset generation ( Wan et al., 2025 ; MiniMax, 2026 ; Lai et al., 2025b ; Lai et al., 2025a ) . However, their growing sequence lengths make attention a major inference bottleneck: its quadratic cost scales rapidly with video duration and output resolution, since it must process spatiotemporal video tokens and geometric 3D tokens. Sparse attention offers a natural remedy, as attention often concentrates on a small subset of token interactions. Yet aggressive sparsity frequently degrades generation quality, leaving a persistent gap between the efficiency of sparse attention and the fidelity of dense attention.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散变换器（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）已成为生成高保真视频和 3D 资产的主流基础架构（Wan 等，2025；MiniMax，2026；Lai 等，2025b；Lai 等，2025a）。 然而，其不断增长的序列长度使得注意力机制成为推理过程中的主要瓶颈：其二次成本会随着视频时长和输出分辨率的增加而迅速上升，因为该机制必须处理时空视频标记和几何 3D 标记。 稀疏注意力提供了一种自然的解决方案，因为注意力通常仅集中在少数标记交互上。 但过度的稀疏化往往会降低生成质量，导致稀疏注意力的效率与密集注意力的保真度之间仍存在持续差距。

paragraphs.en: Most existing methods impose sparsity at block granularity ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) . Block-sparse attention (BSA) selects entire KV blocks for each group of queries, which maps well onto efficient GPU tiles. In practice, block importance is typically estimated from pooled query and key representations ( Li et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026a ) . This design entangles two sources of error: the approximate scores used to pick blocks, and the coarse block layout that restricts which interactions can be picked at all. As a result, it is hard to tell how much of the quality gap stems from the selector, how much from the block structure, and how much persists even when both are improved.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数现有方法都以块级粒度施加稀疏性（Xi et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025c）。 块稀疏注意力（BSA）为每个查询组选择完整的 KV 块，这与高效的 GPU 瓦片结构高度契合。 在实践中，块的重要性通常通过聚合后的查询和键表示来估计（Li et al., 2026b；Li et al., 2026a）。 这种设计将两种误差来源交织在一起：用于选择块的近似分数，以及限制了哪些交互能够被选择的粗略块布局。 因此，很难判断质量差距中有多少源于选择器，多少源于块结构，又有多少即使在两者都得到改进后仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: We examine these questions through controlled oracle comparisons at matched attention densities (i.e., the same sparsity level). Each oracle maximizes the retained attention mass using exact dense-attention probabilities, but differs in selection granularity: the block oracle selects oracle KV blocks for each query group; the token oracle selects or oracle individual KV tokens for each query group; and the per-query oracle further lets every query choose its own KV tokens. Comparing mean-pooled BSA with these oracles, and the oracles with one another, isolates three sources of the quality gap (Fig. 2 ): structural binding error , which arises because KV tokens are bound together in blocks and different queries in the same group share a single selection; selection error , which arises from approximate scoring (e.g. mean pooling); and discarded tail error , which arises because omitted tokens still carry nonzero attention mass. These findings motivate three design principles: finer-grained selection, accurate attention scoring, and compensation for discarded contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过匹配注意力密度（即相同的稀疏度水平）的受控预言机比较来研究这些问题。 每个预言机都使用精确的全注意力概率来最大化保留的注意力质量，但在选择粒度上有所不同：块预言机为每个查询组选择预言机 KV 块；令牌预言机为每个查询组选择单个 KV 令牌；而每查询预言机则进一步允许每个查询自行选择其 KV 令牌。 将均值池化 BSA 与这些预言机进行比较，再将各预言机之间相互比较，可以分离出质量差距的三个来源（图 2）：结构绑定错误（由于 KV 令牌在块中被绑定在一起，且同一组中的不同查询共享单一选择而产生）；选择错误（源于近似评分，例如均值池化）；以及被丢弃的尾部错误（由于被省略的令牌仍然携带非零注意力质量而产生）。 这些发现促成了三项设计原则：更精细的选择、准确的注意力评分，以及对被丢弃贡献的补偿。

paragraphs.en: Realizing these principles efficiently is challenging. First, exact token-level selection requires computing attention scores, which is expensive, and gathering individual KV tokens causes irregular memory access. Second, queries must still be grouped into sufficiently large tiles for efficient GPU execution. Unconstrained clustering can group similar queries to reduce structural binding, but it yields variable-size groups that must be padded to fill the kernel’s computation tiles, wasting computation ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Third, token-level selection removes the block structure that would otherwise provide a natural way to summarize discarded regions for compensation.
paragraphs.zh: 高效地实现这些原则具有挑战性。 首先，精确的令牌级选择需要计算注意力得分，这会带来高昂的计算成本；而逐个收集 KV 令牌则会导致不规则的内存访问。 其次，查询仍然必须被分组为足够大的瓦片，以实现高效的 GPU 执行。 无约束的聚类可以将相似的查询分组在一起以减少结构绑定，但这样会产生大小不一的组，必须通过填充来填满内核的计算瓦片，从而造成计算浪费（Zhou et al., 2026）。 第三，令牌级选择消除了原本可用于总结被丢弃区域以实现补偿的自然块结构。

paragraphs.en: Temporal redundancy across denoising steps offers a way to amortize exact selection and to support compensation. We find that reusing exact selections from earlier steps can outperform recomputing mean-pooled selections at every step, and that the dense–sparse output residual changes little between nearby steps. Building on these observations, we propose Meta-Cached Sparse Attention (MC-Sparse) , a training-free framework that combines token-level KV selection, tile-aligned query grouping, and cross-step reuse. At anchor steps, MC-Sparse groups similar queries into equal-size tiles, selects KV tokens according to their exact attention mass aggregated over each query group, and records the dense–sparse output residual. Subsequent steps reuse the query groups, selected indices, and cached residuals, while computing attention with the current queries, keys, and values. This amortizes the cost of grouping and exact selection, and the cached residuals compensate for the discarded tail across steps. To make this efficient in practice, we develop fast Principal Direction Divisive Partitioning(PDDP) ( Boley, 1998 ) for grouping, a two-pass exact selector for selection, and a token-sparse attention kernel for execution.
paragraphs.zh: 去噪步骤之间的时间冗余提供了一种摊销精确选择并支持补偿的方法。 我们发现，重复使用早期步骤中的精确选择比在每一步重新计算均值池化选择表现更优，并且在相邻步骤之间，稠密-稀疏输出残差的变化很小。 基于这些观察，我们提出了 Meta-Cached Sparse Attention（MC-Sparse），一个无需训练的框架，它结合了令牌级 KV 选择、与瓦片对齐的查询分组以及跨步骤重复使用机制。 在锚定步骤中，MC-Sparse 将相似的查询分组为大小相等的瓦片，根据每个查询组聚合的精确注意力权重来选择 KV 令牌，并记录稠密-稀疏输出残差。 后续步骤会重复使用查询组、选定的索引和缓存的残差，同时使用当前的查询、键和值来计算注意力。 这摊销了分组和精确选择的成本，而缓存的残差则补偿了各步骤中被丢弃的尾部部分。 为了在实践中提高效率，我们为分组开发了快速的主方向分裂分区（PDDP）算法（Boley, 1998），用于选择的二遍精确选择器，以及用于执行的令牌稀疏注意力内核。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We use controlled oracle comparisons to disentangle three sources of quality degradation in sparse attention: structural binding error, selection error, and discarded tail error, and quantify how each affects attention fidelity at matched attention densities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用受控的预言机比较来区分稀疏注意力中导致质量下降的三个来源：结构性绑定错误、选择错误和被丢弃的尾部错误，并量化每个错误在匹配注意力密度下对注意力保真度的影响。

paragraphs.en: We propose MC-Sparse, a training-free framework that combines token-level KV selection and tile-aligned query grouping with cross-step reuse of exact selections and output residuals, together with efficient GPU implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MC-Sparse，一个无需训练的框架，它将令牌级 KV 选择和与瓦片对齐的查询分组相结合，并实现了精确选择和输出残差的跨步重用，同时还提供了高效的 GPU 实现。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of MC-Sparse on multiple diffusion transformer models, spanning both video and 3D asset generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在多种扩散变换器模型上展示了 MC-Sparse 的有效性和通用性，这些模型涵盖了视频和 3D 资产生成领域。

paragraphs.en: Training-free sparse attention. Training-free sparse attention instead aims to approximate full attention in pretrained models while evaluating fewer token interactions. Many approaches organize computation into blocks to exploit FlashAttention-style tiling ( Dao et al., 2022 ) . Block selection uses structured patterns or content-dependent importance estimates, as explored by SVG ( Xi et al., 2025 ) , XAttention ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , and SpargeAttention ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . SVG-EAR ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) and PISA ( Li et al., 2026b ) further approximate contributions from unselected blocks. Block construction commonly forms tile-aligned groups based on spatial or spatiotemporal locality, or after serialization along Hilbert or Z-order curves, with SpargeAttention using Hilbert ordering; semantic clustering in SVG2 ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , SVOO ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , and AdaCluster ( Tan et al., 2026 ) instead produces variable-sized groups whose mismatch with kernel tile boundaries introduces wasted computation within partially filled tiles, reducing actual execution efficiency even without explicit padding. A complementary line of work exploits cross-step redundancy in attention, a strategy also used in diffusion caching ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026c ) . AdaSpa ( Xia et al., 2025 ) , DiTFastAttn ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , and QuantSparse ( Feng et al., 2026 ) reuse attention-related information along the denoising trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 无需训练的稀疏注意力。 无需训练的稀疏注意力则旨在预训练模型中近似全注意力，同时减少需要评估的标记交互次数。 许多方法将计算组织成块，以利用类似 FlashAttention 的分块技术（Dao 等人，2022）。 块的选取采用结构化模式或依赖内容的重要性估计，如 SVG（Xi 等人，2025）、XAttention（Xu 等人，2025）和 SpargeAttention（Zhang 等人，2025b）所探索的那样。 SVG-EAR（Zhou 等人，2026）和 PISA（Li 等人，2026b）进一步近似了未选中块的贡献。 块构建通常基于空间或时空局部性形成与分块对齐的组，或在沿希尔伯特曲线或 Z 序曲线序列化之后进行；其中 SpargeAttention 使用希尔伯特排序。而 SVG2（Yang 等人，2026）、SVOO（Luo 等人，2026）和 AdaCluster（Tan 等人，2026）中的语义聚类则生成大小可变的组，这些组与内核分块边界的错配会在部分填充的分块中引入冗余计算，从而降低实际执行效率，即使没有显式填充也是如此。 另一条互补的研究路线利用了注意力中的跨步冗余性，这一策略也用于扩散缓存（Wang 等人，2026a；Wang 等人，2026c）。 AdaSpa（Xia 等人，2025）、DiTFastAttn（Yuan 等人，2024）和 QuantSparse（Feng 等人，2026）沿降噪轨迹重复利用与注意力相关的信息。

paragraphs.en: We first examine where vanilla BSA loses fidelity relative to dense attention. An oracle selector retains the entries with the largest dense-attention probability mass under a fixed attention density. We consider three oracles (Fig. 2 ): the block oracle selects KV blocks for each query block; the token oracle (shared Q block) selects individual KV tokens but shares one selection within each query block; and the per-query oracle selects KV tokens independently for each query. At matched densities, comparing vanilla BSA with these oracles and with dense attention isolates three sources of the gap: structural binding error, selection error, and discarded tail error.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先研究标准 BSA 在何种情况下相对于密集注意力会失去保真度。 一个神谕选择器会在固定的注意力密度下保留密集注意力概率质量最大的条目。 我们考虑了三种神谕（图 2）：块神谕为每个查询块选择 KV 块；令牌神谕（共享 Q 块）选择单个 KV 令牌，但在每个查询块内共享一次选择；而每查询神谕则为每个查询独立选择 KV 令牌。 在匹配密度下，将标准 BSA 与这些神谕以及密集注意力进行比较，可以分离出差距的三个来源：结构绑定误差、选择误差和被丢弃的尾部误差。

sents.en: We consider three oracles (Fig. 2 ): the block oracle selects KV blocks for each query block; the token oracle (shared Q block) selects individual KV tokens but shares one selection within each query block; and the per-query oracle selects KV tokens independently for each query.
sents.zh: 我们考虑了三种神谕（图 2）：块神谕为每个查询块选择 KV 块；令牌神谕（共享 Q 块）选择单个 KV 令牌，但在每个查询块内共享一次选择；而每查询神谕则为每个查询独立选择 KV 令牌。

sents.en: At matched densities, comparing vanilla BSA with these oracles and with dense attention isolates three sources of the gap: structural binding error, selection error, and discarded tail error.
sents.zh: 在匹配密度下，将标准 BSA 与这些神谕以及密集注意力进行比较，可以分离出差距的三个来源：结构绑定误差、选择误差和被丢弃的尾部误差。

paragraphs.en: Because exact selection and query grouping are costly, MC-Sparse exploits the stability of attention across denoising steps: it performs them only at anchor steps and reuses the resulting query groups, KV indices, and dense–sparse output residual at subsequent reuse steps . In the following subsections, we analyze each error in turn and introduce a corresponding design.
paragraphs.zh: 由于精确选择和查询分组成本高昂，MC-Sparse 利用了去噪步骤中注意力机制的稳定性：它仅在锚定步骤中执行这些操作，并在后续的重用步骤中重复使用由此产生的查询组、KV 索引以及稠密-稀疏输出残差。 在接下来的子部分中，我们将逐一分析每种错误，并引入相应的设计方案。

paragraphs.en: Structural binding error arises from two constraints of block-sparse attention. KV binding forces a block-sparse selector to retain irrelevant neighbors of important tokens, while query binding forces queries with different attention patterns to share one selection (Fig. 3 (a)). Moving from the block oracle to the token oracle with shared query blocks removes KV binding, and moving further to the per-query oracle removes query binding. The accuracy gains at each step (Fig. 2 ) show that both constraints cause losses. Table 4 further confirms this at matched realized densities: finer KV granularity and grouping more similar queries both improve fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 结构绑定错误源于块稀疏注意力中的两个约束。 KV 绑定迫使块稀疏选择器保留重要标记的相关无关邻居，而查询绑定则迫使具有不同注意力模式的查询共享一个选择（图 3 (a)）。 从块预言机转向共享查询块的标记预言机可消除 KV 绑定，而进一步转向每查询预言机则可消除查询绑定。 每一步的准确率提升（图 2）表明这两个约束都会导致性能损失。 表 4 在匹配的已实现密度下进一步证实了这一点：更精细的 KV 颗粒度和对更相似查询的分组都能提高保真度。

paragraphs.en: Tile-aligned query grouping. With head-specific keys and values in MHA, efficient attention tiles must batch queries within each head. We therefore form groups 𝒢 g \mathcal{G}_{g} of C C similar queries that share one KV selection, with C C matched to the kernel’s query tile size. Minimizing within-group variance of 𝐐 \mathbf{Q} is equivalent to maximizing between-group variance. Standard clustering methods such as k k -means do not guarantee equal-size groups, while enforcing hard balance constraints adds assignment overhead and complicates GPU parallelization. We adopt a median-split version of principal direction divisive partitioning (PDDP) ( Boley, 1998 ) : it recursively projects each group onto its principal direction and splits the ordered queries at the median until every group contains exactly C C queries, promoting within-group similarity while maintaining tile alignment. Because a naive PDDP implementation is expensive on GPUs, we develop Fast PDDP as described in Section 4.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 与瓦片对齐的查询分组。 在 MHA 中，由于每个头都有特定的键和值，高效的注意力瓦片必须在每个头内对查询进行批量处理。 因此，我们将 C 个相似的查询组成组 𝒢 g \mathcal{G}_{g}，这些查询共享一个 KV 选择，其中 C 与内核的查询瓦片大小相匹配。 最小化 𝐐 \mathbf{Q} 在组内的方差等价于最大化组间的方差。 k k -means 等标准聚类方法无法保证组的大小相等，而强制施加硬性平衡约束则会增加分配开销并复杂化 GPU 并行化。 我们采用主方向分裂分区法（PDDP）（ Boley, 1998 ）的一种中位数分割版本：该方法递归地将每个组投影到其主方向上，并在有序查询的中位数处进行分割，直到每个组恰好包含 C 个查询，从而促进组内相似性，同时保持与瓦片对齐。 由于朴素的 PDDP 实现会在 GPU 上产生高昂开销，我们开发了如第 4.4 节所述的高效 PDDP（Fast PDDP）。

paragraphs.en: Overall pipeline. MC-Sparse alternates between anchor and reuse steps. At an anchor step, which is the last step of a dense warm-up or refresh segment, we run dense attention, construct query groups, perform exact KV selection, and cache the query groups, selected indices, and output residual. At each subsequent reuse step, the current 𝐐 \mathbf{Q} , 𝐊 \mathbf{K} , and 𝐕 \mathbf{V} are recomputed, while attention uses the cached metadata and residual. Figure 6 illustrates the pipeline; Algorithm 1 gives the corresponding pseudocode.
paragraphs.zh: 整体流程。 MC-Sparse 在锚定步骤和重用步骤之间交替执行。 在锚定步骤中（即密集预热或刷新阶段的最后一步），我们运行密集注意力，构建查询组，执行精确的 KV 选择，并缓存查询组、选中的索引以及输出残差。 在每个后续的重用步骤中，当前的 𝐐 \mathbf{Q}、𝐊 \mathbf{K} 和 𝐕 \mathbf{V} 会被重新计算，而注意力机制则使用已缓存的元数据和残差。 图 6 展示了该流程；算法 1 给出了相应的伪代码。

sents.zh: 在锚定步骤中（即密集预热或刷新阶段的最后一步），我们运行密集注意力，构建查询组，执行精确的 KV 选择，并缓存查询组、选中的索引以及输出残差。

sents.en: At each subsequent reuse step, the current 𝐐 \mathbf{Q} , 𝐊 \mathbf{K} , and 𝐕 \mathbf{V} are recomputed, while attention uses the cached metadata and residual.
sents.zh: 在每个后续的重用步骤中，当前的 𝐐 \mathbf{Q}、𝐊 \mathbf{K} 和 𝐕 \mathbf{V} 会被重新计算，而注意力机制则使用已缓存的元数据和残差。

paragraphs.en: Fast PDDP. We obtain principal directions using batched power iteration, processing all nodes at the same tree depth across attention heads in parallel. paragraphs.en: Tasks and baselines. We evaluate video generation with Minimax-H3-Base ( MiniMax, 2026 ) , HunyuanVideo-13B ( Kong et al., 2025 ) , and Wan2.1-14B-T2V/I2V ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , and image-to-geometry generation with HY3D-Internal. Following SVG-EAR ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , we use Penguin Benchmark prompts for text-to-video and VBench image–prompt pairs for image-to-video, and a detail-oriented image test set for 3D generation. We compare with FA3-based dense attention ( Shah et al., 2024 ) , SVG2, SVG-EAR, Sol-Attn ( Li et al., 2026a ) , PISA ( Li et al., 2026b ) , and SpargeAttn ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , as applicable to each model.

paragraphs.en: Metrics. PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) measure video fidelity to dense-attention outputs, while VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ) measures image quality (ImgQual) and background consistency (BgCons). For 3D assets, we report geometric fidelity using Chamfer distance (CD), volumetric IoU, and F1, and input-image consistency using Uni3D-I ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) and ULIP3D-I ( Xue et al., 2023 ) . Efficiency is measured by attention density, the fraction of retained query–key interactions, and DiT denoising speedup over dense attention, including warm-up but excluding condition encoding and VAE decoding. Detailed settings are provided in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS（Zhang 等人，2018）用于衡量视频与密集注意力输出之间的保真度，而 VBench（Huang 等人，2023）则用于衡量图像质量（ImgQual）和背景一致性（BgCons）。 对于 3D 资产，我们使用切姆弗距离（CD）、体素 IoU 和 F1 报告几何保真度，并使用 Uni3D-I（Zhou 等人，2023）和 ULIP3D-I（Xue 等人，2023）报告输入图像一致性。 效率通过注意力密度（即保留的查询-键交互比例）、DiT 去噪相对于密集注意力的加速效果进行衡量，其中包含预热时间，但不包括条件编码和 VAE 解码。 详细设置见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: Video generation. Table 1 shows improved fidelity and denoising speedup across the evaluated video models. On Minimax-H3-Base, MC-Sparse achieves 28.44 dB PSNR at 25% density and 1.61 × 1.61\times speedup, compared with 23.66 dB and 1.59 × 1.59\times for Sol-Attn at 32.4% density. With the same anchor schedule, MC-Sparse-Flash reaches 1.80 × 1.80\times speedup at 15% density with 27.30 dB PSNR, retaining higher fidelity than both Sol-Attn and PISA. On Hunyuan and Wan, MC-Sparse achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM and the lowest LPIPS among the evaluated sparse methods, with 1.52 × 1.52\times – 1.82 × 1.82\times speedup. The qualitative comparisons in Fig. 7 show that MC-Sparse produces videos visually closer to the dense-attention outputs than the compared sparse methods, consistent with the fidelity metrics. Qualitative results on other video generation models are provided in Fig. 9 .
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成。 表1显示，在评估的视频模型中，MC-Sparse在保真度和去噪速度方面均有提升。 在Minimax-H3-Base上，当密度为25%时，MC-Sparse实现了28.44 dB的PSNR和1.61 × 1.61\times的速度提升，而Sol-Attn在32.4%密度下的对应数值为23.66 dB和1.59 × 1.59\times。 在相同的锚点调度方案下，MC-Sparse-Flash在15%密度时实现了1.80 × 1.80\times的速度提升和27.30 dB的PSNR，同时保持了比Sol-Attn和PISA更高的保真度。 在Hunyuan和Wan上，MC-Sparse在所有评估的稀疏方法中取得了最高的PSNR和SSIM以及最低的LPIPS，并实现了1.52 × 1.52\times至1.82 × 1.82\times的速度提升。 图7中的定性比较显示，与所对比的稀疏方法相比，MC-Sparse生成的视频在视觉上更接近密集注意力方法的输出，这与保真度指标的结果一致。 其他视频生成模型的定性结果见图9。

Starting from vanilla BSA, we successively add exact KV selection with cross-step reuse, token-level KV granularity, query grouping, and residual compensation (Table 3 ). paragraphs.en: We presented MC-Sparse, a training-free framework for accelerating diffusion transformers with token-level sparse attention. Our oracle comparisons show that the dense-to-sparse gap extends beyond selection accuracy to include structural binding and discarded tail contributions. Guided by this analysis, MC-Sparse combines token-level KV selection and tile-aligned query grouping with temporal reuse and residual compensation, balancing approximation quality with execution efficiency. Experiments on video and 3D asset generation demonstrate improved fidelity to dense-attention outputs and reduced denoising latency compared with the evaluated sparse-attention baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MC-Sparse，一个无需训练的框架，可通过令牌级稀疏注意力加速扩散变换器。 我们的神谕比较表明，从密集到稀疏的差距不仅体现在选择准确性上，还涉及结构绑定和被丢弃的尾部贡献。 基于这一分析，MC-Sparse 将令牌级 KV 选择和与瓦片对齐的查询分组与时间复用及残差补偿相结合，在近似质量与执行效率之间取得平衡。 在视频和 3D 资产生成方面的实验表明，与所评估的稀疏注意力基线方法相比，该方法对密集注意力输出的保真度更高，且去噪延迟更低。

paragraphs.en: FlashAttention uses online softmax and does not expose the full normalized attention matrix needed for exact selection. We therefore use two passes: the first returns the dense output and row-wise log-sum-exp values; the second recomputes QK scores and uses these values to recover attention probabilities. We fuse group-wise aggregation into the second pass and apply top- K K to the aggregated attention mass, avoiding materialization of the dense attention matrix.
paragraphs.zh: FlashAttention 使用在线 softmax，并未暴露精确选择所需的完整归一化注意力矩阵。 因此，我们采用两次处理：第一次返回密集输出和逐行的 log-sum-exp 值；第二次重新计算 QK 分数，并利用这些值恢复注意力概率。 我们将组内聚合融合到第二次处理中，并对聚合后的注意力质量应用 top-K，从而避免显式构建密集的注意力矩阵。

paragraphs.en: We implement the token-sparse attention kernel in CuTeDSL with warp-specialized producer and consumer warps. Producer warps resolve selected indices and gather key and value rows asynchronously into shared memory. Consumer warpgroups apply WGMMA operations and online softmax, while a multi-stage pipeline overlaps the next gather with the current computation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 CuTeDSL 中采用针对 warp 的专用生产者与消费者 warp，实现了稀疏令牌注意力内核。 生产者 warp 解析选定的索引，并异步地将键和值行收集到共享内存中。 消费者 warp 组执行 WGMMA 运算和在线 softmax，同时多阶段流水线将下一次收集操作与当前计算重叠执行。

sents.en: We implement the token-sparse attention kernel in CuTeDSL with warp-specialized producer and consumer warps.
sents.zh: 我们在 CuTeDSL 中采用针对 warp 的专用生产者与消费者 warp，实现了稀疏令牌注意力内核。

sents.en: Producer warps resolve selected indices and gather key and value rows asynchronously into shared memory.
sents.zh: 生产者 warp 解析选定的索引，并异步地将键和值行收集到共享内存中。

sents.en: Consumer warpgroups apply WGMMA operations and online softmax, while a multi-stage pipeline overlaps the next gather with the current computation.
sents.zh: 消费者 warp 组执行 WGMMA 运算和在线 softmax，同时多阶段流水线将下一次收集操作与当前计算重叠执行。
